description_en: Deletes an access control policy from a specified VPC firewall policy group
description_zh: 删除指定VPC防火墙策略组的访问控制策略
name: DeleteVpcFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy for the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

To delete an access control policy, you must provide the unique ID of the policy. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

删除安全访问控制策略时，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control policy group for the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html operation to obtain the ID.

Valid values:

If the VPC firewall protects a CEN instance, the value is the instance ID of the CEN instance.

   Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\*

If the VPC firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, the value is the instance ID of the VPC firewall.
  
  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\*
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html接口获取该ID。

取值：

VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。

   例如：cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。
  
  例如：vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id
